capabilities: sync vault files with cloud storage services
schedule auto sync or sync on save
skip large files or paths by regex rules
disambiguation: Not a backup tool; it keeps a vault in sync across devices through a cloud service acting as broker.
extras: Freemium: Google Drive, Box, pCloud, Yandex Disk, Koofr, Azure Blob Storage, OneDrive full access and smart conflict merging are PRO (paid) features. Users supply their own cloud accounts, whose API and storage costs are their responsibility; the plugin is source-available rather than fully open source.
intentEvidence: This is yet another unofficial sync plugin for Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is a paid service, so users who want to sync vaults across mobile and desktop need a way to use their own cloud storage as the relay.

relations.evidence: You can also use Obsidian42 - BRAT to install this plugin.

requires.name: Remotely Save PRO for extra services and smart conflict

summary: Vault sync plugin that mirrors notes to user-chosen cloud storage (S3, Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV, Google Drive and more) with encryption and conflict handling.
